senses.gloss: pr. n. pl.(b. h. נְטֹפָה)Netofah, near Bethlehem in Juda.
units: Gen. R. s. 79 בקעתא דבית נ׳ the valley of Beth N.; Yalk. Koh. 972; (Gen. R. s. 10 טרפא); v. טוֹפֶת.—נ׳(ה) זית name of a species of olives, Netofah olive.

<cite ref="Mishnah Peah 7:1">Peah VII, 1</cite> an olive which bore at one time a special name <he>כזית נ׳ בשעתו</he> (<cite ref="A02675"><he>אפי׳</he></cite>) Ms. M. (ed. <he>הנ׳</he>) (even if it be) like the N. olive; <cite ref="Tosefta Peah 3:9">Tosef. ib. III, 9</cite>. Y. ib. VII, beg. 20ᵃ <he>היו שניהן נ׳</he> if two of the trees were N. trees; <he>היתה כל שדהו נ׳</he> if all the trees of his field were N. Ib. (defining <he>נ׳</he>) <he>נוטף שמן</he> one dripping oil, contrad. to <cite ref="U01768"><he>שפכוני</he></cite> (pouring), yielding large quantities of oil. Ib. <he>והתנו נטיפה</he> (corr. acc.).—Denom.:
